3: Now, let's look at the cat\.
Does the cat have the cake

messages.text: Look, Mouse sees a cat. Listen. Cat. /k/ /æ/ /t/ Cat. Your turn. Cat.[TEACHER_CAT_PAWS][TEACHER_LISTEN][STUDENT_TALK]
Yes, cat. A cat says meow meow. Listen. Meow meow. Your turn. Meow meow.[TEACHER_APPLAUD][TEACHER_CAT_PAWS][TEACHER_LISTEN][STUDENT_TALK]
Yes, I like dogs. Now, let's look at the cat. Does the cat have the cake? Say yes or no.[TEACHER_LISTEN][STUDENT_TALK]
